scope: Full repository assessment, not a diff review

advisoryCoverage.source: GitHub REST global security advisories, ecosystem=maven, exact affects package@resolved-version filters
advisoryCoverage.authentication: Unauthenticated HTTPS REST requests using Python urllib; gh api was not used.
advisoryCoverage.rangeAttribution: Numeric dotted release comparison; milestone lower bounds compare by numeric release components; all resolved vulnerable-package versions are releases. Only matching package/range entries attributed.
advisoryCoverage.dependencyScope: All 104 resolved Maven coordinates, including transitive and test-scoped dependencies; not direct-only.
advisoryCoverage.excludedTransitiveVulnerabilities: None excluded because of transitive status. Dependency implementation source was not audited; advisory matches are not an exploitability verdict.

cweCoverage.language: Java and browser JavaScript with deployment shell/SQL and configuration inspection
reviewedAreas: All first-party src/main Java classes and interfaces
Build POM and first-party documentation/configuration for credential patterns
exclusions: Tests and generated files excluded from CWE conclusions
Assessment skills and generated assessment artifacts are not application attack surfaces

limitations: No source edits, test execution, compilation, application startup, exploitation, runtime tracing, concurrency stress testing or git commits performed.
NOT_FOUND means no confirmed instance in reviewed first-party code; it is not a security certification. Native JVM/image-decoder internals and dependency implementation source were not audited.
CVE matching covers 104 resolved direct/transitive Maven coordinates including test dependencies, not build plugins, container OS/JRE/Oracle image vulnerabilities, or CDN Bootstrap resources.

Advisory findings reflect the live advisory database response; deployment feature prerequisites, optional dependency packaging and test-only applicability require follow-up before asserting exploitability.
Maven resolution succeeded for both commands; no build-resolution failure occurred. No dependency fallback was needed.
Public photo reads are intentional; authenticated mutations, parameter-bound JPA queries, upload byte/pixel limits and stream/reader disposal were taken into account.

Upload image MIME is client-declared; unrecognized image headers are not rejected, but dangerous execution/active-content delivery was not established, so CWE-434 is NOT_FOUND rather than speculative.

Oracle initialization interpolates deployment-controlled environment values into SQL; no lower-trust application request input reaches that administrative configuration in the examined repository, so SQL injection is not claimed.

Credential sample values and test-only values were excluded as deployed hard-coded credentials. Runtime admin/database secrets are required environment references; no credential values are reproduced.
Authentication audit completeness depends on framework/deployment logging, not verified; absence of custom logging alone is not reported as CWE-778.
Spring singleton beans have configuration/dependency fields, while request mutation state is local and persistence is transaction-managed. No confirmed concurrency invariant violation established.

DOM XSS is demonstrated by static source-to-sink tracing; no browser proof-of-concept run. Unbounded gallery BLOB allocation is a static resource-management finding; heap thresholds were not measured.
Parent coordinator owns report.json injection, report rendering and copying. This task writes standalone merged reports and unified-findings.json only.
tooling: Executed the seven requested security skills sequentially and security-assessment-merge. Named appmod-cve-assessment and cwe-rules-assessment were unavailable and were not run. Results were written with shell/Python because write_assessment_result was unavailable.
